XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Malfunction of indicators and hazard warning lights

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a car repairer; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Lighting

  • Device: Hazard warning light switch

  • Fault: Occasionally, the direction indicators remain on continuously without flashing, fail to switch off, or flash rapidly. Similarly, the hazard warning lights may remain on continuously, fail to switch off, or flash abnormally and too rapidly.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty hazard warning light switch

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the hazard warning light switch and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located on the centre console, above the air conditioning controls. The faulty switch showed no visible defects and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.

    The estimated time for the service is approximately 0.7 h.
